item.title: Austin ISD released from TEA oversight over special education
item.description: Austin ISD says it has been released from state oversight of its special education services.AISD has been under TEA oversight since approving the plan in late 2023. AISD announced it completed all required actions under its Special Education Agreed Order with the TEA on Tuesday, Feb. 17.Prior to the appointment of state monitors, it was discovered that AISD had over 600 initial evaluations which were out of the timeline for students. item.title: Texas GOP attorney general candidates face off in debate in Dallas
item.description: The Texas Attorney General Republican Primary Debate welcomed the four GOP candidates to the stage, where the politicians faced off Tuesday night. item.title: San Marcos City Council considers proposal for controversial data center
item.description: San Marcos leaders are considering whether to allow plans to build a new data center in the city. This comes after Hays County Judge Ruben Becerra says the water crisis is severe and getting worse, with aquifer levels dropping to historic lows.Dozens of people showed up to speak about the proposed data center on Tuesday.
